content_sections.heading: How to Apply
content_sections.text: Candidates who wish to apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow Recruitment 2026 via email should follow the steps below. Read the official notification carefully before applying. Prepare your application with complete bio-data including personal details, educational qualifications, and experience. Attach self-attested copies of all required documents such as educational certificates, experience certificates, ID proof, and recent passport-size photographs. Clearly mention the post applied for in the subject line of the email. Send the complete application to the official email address mentioned in the notification. Ensure the email is sent before the last date: 04-10-2026. Keep a copy of the sent email for future reference.

faq.question: Q1. What is the conducting organization for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The recruitment is conducted by the Indian Institute of Technology Indore (IIT Indore) for filling up Junior Research Fellow positions under government field guidelines.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There is a total of 1 vacancy available for the Junior Research Fellow post in this recruitment notification released by IIT Indore.

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to apply for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow posts?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application via email is 4 October 2026. Candidates must ensure they submit their documents before this deadline.

faq.question: Q4. What is the walk-in or interview date for this recruitment?
faq.answer: The scheduled date of the interview for the shortlisted candidates is 5 October 2026. Make sure to check the notification for specific venue details.

faq.question: Q5. What is the mode of application for IIT Indore Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: Candidates can apply for these positions through Email mode by sending their complete bio-data and necessary self-attested documents to the specified address.

faq.question: Q6. What educational qualifications are required for Junior Research Fellow?
faq.answer: Candidates must possess a First class in M.Sc Chemistry/Biochemistry or B.Tech Biological Sciences, B.Pharm/M.Pharm with a valid GATE, UGC/CSIR-LS, GPAT Rank or Score.

faq.question: Q7. What is the age limit for applying to IIT Indore JRF positions?
faq.answer: The minimum age limit is 20 years and the maximum age limit is 25 years for applicants wishing to apply for the Junior Research Fellow post.

faq.question: Q8. What is the salary or stipend offered for this post?
faq.answer: Selected candidates for the Junior Research Fellow position will receive a salary of Rs. 44,440 per month, which is inclusive of 20% HRA.

faq.question: Q9. Is there any application fee required to apply for IIT Indore Recruitment?
faq.answer: No, there is no application fee for General, OBC, SC, and ST category candidates. The application fee for all categories is Nil.

faq.question: Q10. What is the selection process for IIT Indore Junior Research Fellow recruitment?
faq.answer: The selection process for the candidates applying for the Junior Research Fellow post consists of an Interview conducted by the institution.
